senses.gloss: f. (לָתַת) moistening the grain before grinding.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 36a:14">Pes. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ ליתה בזריזין</he> the moistening is not done by careful persons (priests).
<cite ref="Pesachim 40a:14">Ib. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>אי אפשר לנקייה בלא ל׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="N01208"><he>נקייה</he></cite>) white flour cannot be produced without moistening.
<cite ref="Pesachim 40a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>אי לא דבעי ל׳ וכ׳</he> if it required no moistening what is the guard for? (v. <cite ref="U00960"><he>שִׁימּוּר</he></cite>).
